description: 72-hour earthquake probability forecasts by SeismoAI's LightGBM+XGBoost model (v23.0, 230 features). Each prediction is a 1° grid cell with probabilities for M5.5+, M6.0+, M7.0+ events. Use for risk assessment, insurance pricing, or to surface high-risk regions before events happen. Premium ($0.05/call): real model output (wAUC/BSS-validated), not a public USGS scrape.
name: alya_seismic_forecast
